trigger: Pass the man with a crank radio in the ration line.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A man in line is cranking a radio. A dozen people lean in. The voice is warm, tired, local.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: This is KK7AUG, Peavine Peak, still here. Day nineteen. Here's what I've got.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: Sacramento's got power downtown. Allegedly. Salt Lake's handing out MREs at the fairgrounds. Allegedly.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: Transformer shipments from Korea in ninety days. I'd like that one to be true. So would you.

nodes.speaker: augie
nodes.text: If you've got a radio and batteries, get to me. I need ears in Sparks. KK7AUG, out.

choices.text: He's making half of that up.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The man cranking shrugs. 'So? It's the only voice that isn't a loudspeaker.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: 'North. The towers on the ridge. Old guy. Fixes everyone's CB.' You file it away.
